answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 37945 Country: India Title: Suggestion on keeping the name Maryam Zahra Question: Allah subah-na-hu-taala have blessed me with a baby girl (after 4 generations a girl has born in family) and we want to name her Maryam Zahra, so will it be right to name her Maryam Zahra, or should we keep her name Maryam only? Thanks! Answer ID: 37945 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 569/480/B=1433) May she be blessing for you, may Allah make her pious and righteous and may she be given longevity and prosperity! You can keep any of the two names: Maryam or Maryam Zahra. Both names are right. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
